# Introduction {.unnumbered}

::: {.callout-warning}
This chapter is a placeholder. Content planned: what this site is and its
relationship to WRE / R Internals / Advanced R; audience and prerequisites;
conventions used throughout (always `R_NO_REMAP` + `Rf_`/`R_` prefixes, C not
C++, `.Call` only); the API status taxonomy (API / experimental / embedding /
non-API) and what "don't use non-API" means in practice; which headers to
include.
:::

Out of scope for this site: the `.C`/`.Fortran` interface as a recommended
approach, embedding R / writing front-ends, the graphics engine API, and
non-API entry points except where the [compliance appendix](A-compliance.qmd)
maps them to replacements.
